## Outcome: campaign-exhausted

Every scope family was inventoried, specified, implemented, executed, and independently verified; the clock, not the fleet, stopped further progress — boundary residuals were still closable at the implementation cutoff (T-22min), which is why this is **exhausted**, not converged.

## What the campaign produced (all on member branches, integrated on mine)

- **Inventory** (`rules/app-inventory.json` v3): all 8 scope families — 7 routes, auth exemptions, validation/default/null handling, project/task mutations, bulkClose, filters and all 6 whitelisted/default sorts, API readback/escaping/nulls, schema constraints and DAO mappings, seed, JSP-observable behavior, technical Java paths, and no-executable-counter files (18/18 javaSources accounted; TaskStatus zero-executable-lines noted).
- **Rules/specs**: 45 rules (R-*) and 52 EARS specs (S-*) with file:line citations; 2 spec-text errors corrected in-run with explanations; observed-vs-intended discipline throughout; intended-vs-characterization labeled per test.
- **Tests**: 137 external real-HTTP unittest tests (8 modules), per-test DB reset, persistence asserted through the read-only oracle, refusal cases assert no mutation, exact ordering asserted for every sort token. `mapping.json`: 137 mapped, 0 unmapped, 0 orphan links.
- **Execution**: engineer 4x green runs (129→137 tests); **verifier independently ran the suite 3x** (fresh / no-reset dirty-DB / fresh) on its own runtime at integration commit b38f8da — 137 OK, exit 0 each; JaCoCo coverage reproduced exactly: INSTRUCTION 1993/2155 (92.6%), BRANCH 168/188 (89.4%), LINE 452/500 (90.4%), METHOD 103/108, CLASS 17/17 vs the full 18-file denominator; per-family audit PASS ×8.
- **Findings** (`findings/ledger.json`): 11 candidates D-001..D-011, each with a reproducible case and my adjudication. D-002 (MEMBER bulkClose closes PENDING_APPROVAL — approval-policy bypass) and D-010 (ghost update reports success on nonexistent id) were **independently reproduced by the verifier**; D-004/D-008 families confirmed as observed; D-011 (UTF-8 mojibake) found by the verifier's own probing. Reproduction was treated as observed behavior, not proof of intent — suspected defects and unresolved ambiguities (D-002, D-003, D-004, D-008, D-009, D-010, D-011) are retained as such. No app edits; no test weakened, skipped, or deleted.
- **Reports**: `reports/run-summary.json` (breadth by family, commits, coverage, adjudications, achieved/unmet, next-run work), `reports/attempts.json` (14 items, no allowance exhausted), verifier evidence in `reports/verification/` and `evidence/verifier/`.
